scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install --ignore-scripts && npm run build
scripts.dev:with-python-fallback: concurrently -k -n server,client,python -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:python-fallback"
